stories.text: Five teenagers were stabbed at a Halloween party in Chandler's Ford, and Hampshire Police believe an unknown group got into the address.
Nine people died when a jet crashed in flames in Florida near President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort, which Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy called a terrible tragedy.
Virgin Media O2 plans to cut thousands of jobs, though the broadband firm has not yet settled on the exact number of roles.
A row among Democrats in Detroit, Michigan has shaken the party just days before the US midterm elections, BBC's Nada Tawfik reports.
Kimi Antonelli is the youngest Formula 1 world champion ever after clinching the title as Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix.
A new warning system in A and E departments in England will help staff spot children whose condition worsens quickly while awaiting emergency care.
King Charles III will speak on slavery in Antigua on Tuesday, ending his Caribbean tour, with the prime minister open to a possible UK apology.
Olympian Ciara Mageean, a former European 1500 metres champion, has died of bowel cancer at 34, three weeks after marrying her partner.
Adventurer Karl Bushby crossed the Humber Bridge near the end of a 28-year, 31,000-mile journey around the world, due to finish in Hull on Monday.
Binance users pulled out 3.6 billion dollars after a record crypto hack affecting 6.3 billion dollars in digital assets, and the exchange froze transactions.
